messages: Hi Sam, the pilot moves to March 12, budget unchanged. Kim
Attached is contract v3. We changed the notice period to 60 days. Lee
Can we move Thursday's demo to 15:00? Noor
We need 24 seats instead of 18 for the pilot. Kim
Invoice 2041 over 3,200 euros is due on November 30. Lee
I will send you the new quote by Friday. Sam
The venue for the offsite is booked, Hall B. Andrea
The board pack needs your numbers by Wednesday. Dana
For the Birch workshop I can do December 3. Kim
The invoice for the flyers is 410 euros. Omar
Your reserved book The Long Walk is ready to pick up until November 16.
Dinner on Saturday at seven, bring the board games. Robin
Your dentist appointment is on November 18 at 10:30.
Your energy invoice of 96 euros is ready. It is collected on November 20.
The photos of the trip are in the shared album. Robin
Training moves to the north field from next week. Jo
The match fee of 15 euros is due before Sunday. Jo
Can you pick up bread on the way?
The plumber comes on Tuesday at nine.

cases.q: You should check the mailbox from sam@home.example
cases.fact: It tells what is new in that mailbox: the reserved library book that is ready, and/or Robin's dinner on Saturday, and/or the dentist on November 18. It must not say it doesn't know the address, or that the mailbox is or may not be connected.

cases.q: wat is er binnengekomen op sam@home.example?
cases.fact: It tells what came in there: the library book, and/or Robin's dinner, and/or the dentist appointment.

cases.q: Regarde la boîte mail sam@home.example, il y a du nouveau ?
cases.fact: It tells what is new there: the library book, and/or Robin's dinner, and/or the dentist appointment.

cases.q: what's new in my personal mail?
cases.fact: It tells what is new in the personal mail: the library book, and/or Robin's dinner, and/or the dentist; it may add that the Outlook mailbox (also personal) can't be read since November 5. It tells nothing from work mail or WhatsApp.

cases.q: is er nog iets belangrijks in mijn persoonlijke mail?
cases.fact: It names things from the personal mail, like the dentist appointment on November 18, the energy invoice, the library book or the dinner; it may add that the Outlook mailbox (also personal) can't be read since November 5. It tells nothing from work mail or WhatsApp.

cases.q: anything new in sam.hale@club.example?
cases.fact: It says this mailbox can't be read at the moment (it needs help or a new sign-in, in Connections) or was last read on November 5, so newer mail isn't known; it may add the latest it has: training moves to the north field.

cases.q: werkt mijn mailbox sam.hale@club.example nog?
cases.fact: It says no, or that there is a problem: the mailbox is connected but needs help and was last read on November 5.

cases.q: Quoi de neuf dans ma boîte du club, sam.hale@club.example ?
cases.fact: It says this mailbox can't be read now or was last read on November 5 (so newer mail isn't known); it may add the latest: training moves to the north field.

cases.q: is sam@birch.example connected?
cases.fact: Yes, it is connected.

cases.q: check the mailbox sam@nowhere.example please
cases.fact: It says that sam@nowhere.example isn't connected, and that it can be added in Connections.

cases.q: wat is er nieuw in mijn mailbox sam.old@post.example?
cases.fact: It says that sam.old@post.example isn't connected, and that it can be added in Connections (Koppelingen).

cases.q: As-tu lu ma boîte sam@ailleurs.example ?
cases.fact: It says that sam@ailleurs.example isn't connected, and that it can be added in Connections (Connexions).

cases.q: is there an invoice in my mailbox sam@home.example?
cases.fact: Yes: the energy invoice of 96 euros (Volt Energy), collected on November 20. It must not mention invoice 2041 or the flyers.

cases.q: staat er iets over een factuur in mijn birch mailbox?
cases.fact: Yes: the invoice for the flyers of 410 euros (Omar). It must not mention invoice 2041 or the energy invoice.

cases.q: what does my mailbox sam@birch.example say about the dentist?
cases.fact: It says there is nothing about the dentist in that mailbox. It may add the appointment on November 18, only if it says that is from another mailbox (sam@home.example).

cases.q: what did Kim write to my sam@birch.example mailbox?
cases.fact: Kim can do December 3 for the Birch workshop. It must not mention the pilot, March or seats.

cases.q: Qu'est-ce que Robin a écrit dans ma boîte sam@home.example ?
cases.fact: Robin wrote about dinner on Saturday at seven with the board games, and that the trip photos are in the shared album. It must not mention bread or the plumber.

cases.q: wat zei Robin op WhatsApp?
cases.fact: Robin asked to pick up bread and said the plumber comes Tuesday at nine. It must not mention dinner or photos.

cases.q: what came in last week in my mailbox sam@home.example?
cases.fact: Only the messages of November 2 to 8: Robin's dinner on Saturday (came in on November 8), the dentist appointment (November 6). It must not mention the library book, or the energy invoice.

cases.q: wat kwam er vandaag binnen op sam@acme.example?
cases.fact: Today: Kim's pilot moves to March 12, and Lee's contract v3 with a notice period of 60 days. It must not mention the board pack.

cases.q: what's the latest in my Birch Gmail?
cases.fact: The board pack needs numbers by Wednesday (Dana), and possibly Kim's workshop on December 3. It must not mention the pilot or contract v3.

cases.q: wat is er nieuw in mijn tweede Gmail?
cases.fact: The board pack needs numbers by Wednesday (Dana), and possibly Kim's workshop on December 3. It must not mention the pilot or contract v3.

cases.q: check my mail
cases.fact: It tells some of what is new in the mail: for example Kim's pilot to March, contract v3, the board pack or the library book. It must not claim it just checked or synced the mail; it may say up to when mail was read.

cases.q: check mijn werkmail even
cases.fact: It tells some of what is new in work mail: for example Kim's pilot to March, contract v3 or the board pack. Nothing personal. It must not claim it just checked or synced the mail.

cases.q: what's new in my mailbox sam@home.example?
cases.fact: It says that mailbox is Personal, and so not in view here (Work): pick Personal or All. Nothing from that mailbox is told.

cases.q: what did Kim say last week?
cases.fact: Last week (November 2 to 8) Kim asked for 24 seats instead of 18, and can do December 3 for the Birch workshop. It must not mention the pilot moving to March (this week).

cases.q: wat heeft Lee Park over het contract geschreven?
cases.fact: Contract v3 changed the notice period to 60 days.

cases.q: Qui m'a écrit hier ?
cases.fact: On November 8: Robin (dinner on Saturday), and Noor (move Thursday's demo to 15:00).

cases.q: how many seats do we need for the pilot?
cases.fact: 24 seats instead of 18.

cases.q: what did I promise Lee?
cases.fact: To send the new quote by Friday.

cases.q: what did Zephyr Quill say last week?
cases.fact: Nothing was found from Zephyr Quill, said simply. It must not say that messages don't establish something, or speak of 'these messages'.

cases.q: heeft peter@elders.example nog iets gestuurd?
cases.fact: Nothing was found from peter@elders.example, said simply, or NO ANSWER.

cases.q: Qu'a dit Andrea cette semaine ?
cases.fact: Andrea sent nothing this week; the latest, of October 31, says that the venue for the offsite is booked, Hall B.

cases.q: send Kim an email that March is fine
cases.fact: Either it shows no answer at all (NO ANSWER), or it says that it can't do that here and where to ask for it (a new to-do). It must not claim it was or will be sent, or that it was asked or allowed.

cases.q: sync my mailbox sam@home.example now
cases.fact: Either it shows no answer at all (NO ANSWER), or it says it can't start that here, or only says up to when that mailbox was read and/or what is in it. It must not claim it synced or checked just now.
